# S1.5 — Land the event store / run ledger (§5a.1, R-2.2.1)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §5a.1 (R-2.2.1) · ADR-0026/0027/0028/0029 (as
amended) · **Ticket:** `docs/tickets/009_S1.5__run-ledger.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.2.1**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.4` (stacked) · **Stage:** 1 · **Live stage:**
offline-only

## Summary
Lands the C0/Stage-1 §5a.1 event store / run ledger as a new **persistent** workspace
crate `crates/hh-ledger` — the typed, append-only, hash-chained event log every other
run-scoped state is a rebuildable projection of (ADR-0026 §1–§2). The full Stage-1
interface surface is executable: `open_run` (seq-0 `lifecycle.run.created` + writer
lease), `acquire_writer`/`renew`/`release` (one fenced writer per run),
`append` (atomic batches, durable-before-visible over a WAL with commit markers),
`read`/`head`/`subscribe` (inclusive cursors, fwd/rev, replay+live frames), and
`put_blob`/`get_blob` (content-addressed, deduplicated blob offload) — plus `verify`
(typed `Tampered{at_seq, kind}`), `project(context_view, run_summary)` (rebuildable
folds stamped with `(run_id, seq)` + `view_policy_version` + `view_hash`), and
`lineage` (root-first `forked_from`/`continued_from` resolution with anchors verified
at `open_run`). The C0 class set is one declared persistence-policy table (81 rows);
the per-run hash chain is `idp/1`-domain-separated (`ledger.event`, RFC-6962 leaf
byte); every envelope carries the §5a.1 §3 field set including `schema_version`,
`lease_generation`, `participant_class`, `observability_level`, `causes[]`, `ir_refs`
and `surface_ids`.

**Opens DF-S1.5-{1,2,3}** (Stage-2 ops; metric-registry observability resolution;
cross-implementation golden corpus — pointer at DF-S1.2-2). Closes none.

## What changed
- **`crates/hh-ledger/`** (new, persistent workspace member; deps `hh-wire`,
  `hh-identity`, `hh-provenance`, `hh-ontology` only — no `hh-hir` edge, CC5).
  Modules: `errors` (the §5a.1-named typed refusals + `Tampered` + documented
  additions), `ids` (creation-time-sortable allocated ids, injectable `Clock`/
  `IdSource`, derived `effect_id`, RFC-3339-ms `ts` check), `manifest` (`RunManifest`
  + `open_run` validation: run-kind/ADR-0183-§C rules, pinned-ref → `UnresolvedRef`,
  lineage anchors), `classes` (the **one** declared persistence-policy table),
  `event` (`Event`/`EventEnvelope`/`EphemeralRecord`, cursors/filters/pages,
  `EventFrame` sum), `schema` (canonical envelope form, `schema_version` gate →
  `SchemaMismatch`, deprecation registry, `event_hash`), `views` (`context_view`,
  `run_summary`), `store` (WAL + commit markers + torn-tail drop, persisted fenced
  lease, subscriber fan-out, blob pool, `verify`, `project`, `lineage`).
- **`crates/hh-provenance/`** — `decode.rs`: canonical `from_json` decoders for
  `ProvenanceRecord`, `Label`, `LabelEndorsed`, `EndorsementBasis`, `ContentKind`,
  `Origin`, `AuthorityClass`, `PersistenceScope` (CC8 additive; CC7 — the schema
  source owns its decoder; the ledger keeps no private copy).
- **Build memory:** `docs/adr/ADR-0233`, `ADR-0234`, `ADR-0235` (+ regenerated index);
  `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` — `DF-S1.5-1`, `DF-S1.5-2`, `DF-S1.5-3` → OPEN;
  `docs/build/runs/S1.5.md`; `docs/build/BUILD_INDEX.md` + `docs/build/LEDGER.md`.

## Design decisions
- **Crate shape (ADR-0233).** `hh-ledger` sits above wire/identity/provenance/
  ontology; `ir_refs` are `hh-identity` `IrRef` coordinates, never IR nodes. Storage
  is a file-backed canonical-JSONL WAL (`runs/<id>/events.wal` + `lease.json` +
  `blobs/<digest>`); all in-memory state is a rebuildable projection.
- **Class table (ADR-0234).** Interim rulings: audit-grade = the §5a.1 §6 list +
  `lifecycle.run.suspended` + every `action.effect.*` phase + `model.call.{requested,
  completed,failed}`; kernel-origin on all `lifecycle.*`/`action.environment.*`/
  `action.world_state.*`; `security.permission.*` over-declared provenance-mandatory
  pending the §8.1 spelling reconciliation; Rule C enforced as an interim 4 KiB
  audit-payload cap until the §05g `audit_fields` whitelists land.
- **Hash/WAL/lease (ADR-0235).** `hash = idp_id("ledger.event", 0x00 ‖ canonical(env
  −{hash}) ‖ prev_hash)`; seq-0 `prev_hash` = `"genesis"` or the verified lineage
  anchor. A batch commits iff its `{"k":"c"}` marker line is durable — replay drops
  trailing uncommitted lines wholesale. The lease is a persisted `lease.json` whose
  generation strictly increases on takeover; every envelope carries it as the fencing
  token; takeover audits `lifecycle.lease.fenced`.

## Test evidence
- `cargo test --workspace` — **366 passed / 0 failed** (`hh-ledger` 49: 23 unit + 26
  acceptance; `hh-provenance` +4 decoder tests over the S1.4 313 baseline).
- `cargo fmt --all --check` — clean; `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets
  -- -D warnings` — 0 warnings.
- **AC-R-2.2.1-1** append-only: no op mutates durable events; `verify` detects edit /
  delete / reorder / truncate / late-insert / dangling-parent (`ac10_*`).
- **AC-R-2.2.1-3** rebuildability: delete + reopen ⇒ identical `view_hash` on both
  view kinds (`ac3_*`).
- **AC-R-2.2.1-5** stamping: 100 % of envelopes carry the five required stamps
  (`ac5_*`; the registry-resolution half is DF-S1.5-2).
- **AC-R-2.2.1-7** offload: oversized inline payloads refused `SchemaViolation`;
  blob dedup same-bytes⇒same-address, integrity re-hash on read (`ac14_*` blob tests).
- **AC-R-2.2.1-8** schema gate: v1 golden fixtures load, v2 → `SchemaMismatch`,
  deprecation registry checked in (`ac8_*`, schema unit tests).
- **AC-R-2.2.1-10** ordering: dense `seq`, parent must pre-exist (acyclic by
  construction), cross-run `causes[]` resolve or refuse (`order-*`/lineage/causes).
- **AC-R-2.2.1-11** single writer: `WouldBlock` on a live lease, takeover on expiry,
  stale append → `Fenced` + audited `lifecycle.lease.fenced` (`ac7_*`).
- **AC-R-2.2.1-12** ephemeral discipline: `model.stream.delta` / executor chunks /
  `requested{rendering}` on `subscribe`, never in `read`; one declared table (`ac12_*`).
- **AC-R-2.2.1-14** canonical byte equality: pinned golden transcript — canonical
  event bytes + head hash byte-stable (`golden_transcript_is_byte_stable`;
  cross-implementation half is DF-S1.5-3/DF-S1.2-2).
- Provenance battery green: `MissingProvenance`, `AuthorityExceedsOrigin`,
  `TextAboveExternal`, `TaintedAboveExternal`, `IllegitimateEndorsement`,
  `ScopeCeilingExceeded`, `AttestationInvalid` (`provenance_rules_*`,
  `illegitimate_endorsement_*`).

## Out of scope (spec staging, not gaps)
`fork`/`navigate`/`redact`/`gc`, retention tiers, GC pinning, signed checkpoints,
audit tree heads (C0 · Stage 2 — DF-S1.5-1); replay driver, artefact chain,
interchange identifiability, `audit_completeness` (Stage 3); subagent lineage, hosted
ingestion, derived-index latency (Stage 4); `control.*`/`measurement.*` class families
(land with their producers); takeover *policy* (R-2.2.3); Hosting-ABI lowering
(R-2.10.6).
